name: Mini Utopia Golden Style Anchor Verdicts v1
review_basis: First real-asset Godot lineup under fixed Style Calibration Lab lighting

status_definitions.style_anchor: May define Mini Utopia geometry/style language and appear in GPT style sheets.
status_definitions.direct_use: Compatible for production use after palette/scale/gameplay checks, but does not define the style.
status_definitions.gameplay_utility: Useful structural/gameplay module; do not use as a primary visual style reference.
status_definitions.conditional: Potentially usable but requires another compatibility/material/palette check before Golden promotion.
status_definitions.archive: Do not use for current Canon production.

forest_tree_round.reason: Strong C+ silhouette: rounded organic crown, simple trunk, readable toy masses.

forest_tree_branching.reason: Compatible but more cuboid; useful variation, not a primary anti-voxel style reference.

forest_bush.reason: Simple rounded mass, highly reusable environment dressing.

forest_rock.reason: Clean faceted mass and readable scale; good utility nature prop.

medieval_home.reason: Excellent architecture anchor: chunky structure, clear roof/body hierarchy, toy-like proportions.

medieval_tower.reason: Strong vertical landmark language with readable large/medium forms.

medieval_bridge.reason: Compatible modular architecture; useful for assembly but not identity-bearing enough to anchor style.

platformer_platform.reason: Useful gameplay geometry but too prototype/block-like to define final visual language.

platformer_slope.reason: Useful traversal module; retain for mechanics and blockout, not GPT style reference.

dungeon_chest.reason: Readable chunky prop with strong primary/secondary mass separation.

adventurer_knight.reason: Matches compact playable character proportions and supports the character Canon.

skeleton_minion.reason: Good gameplay creature/enemy fit; secondary to Adventurer for character style authority.

kenney_castle_tower.reason: Current lineup presentation does not blend cleanly as-is. Retest one additional representative Kenney Castle asset after material/palette normalization before broader promotion.
